decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions and alterations to the public house, creation of family room at first floor level, and associated parking and access arrangements, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics, and would improve this existing community use. The proposal would be compatible with the appearance of the building and the character of the street scene, and would not harm the living conditions of adjoining occupiers or result in conditions harmful to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area. On balance, the development accords with policy ENV-B.1.1, C.1.4 and T.1.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is used.

Condition : 5 - The access doorways to the public house shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 6 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 7 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 8 - The building shall be insulated against noise emissions in accordance with a scheme to prevent unacceptable noise transmission between the premises and adjoining dwellings and between the family room and the residential accommodation on the second floor, details of which shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before commencement of the development.  The details so approved shall be implemented before the extensions are first brought into use and permanently retained.

Condition : 9 - The first floor windows to the proposed family room shall be kept permanently closed and the room shall be ventilated by means of a system of mechanichal ventilation, the details of which shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before commencement of the development.  The details so approved shall be implemented before the extensions are first brought into use and shall be permanently retained.

Condition : 10 - The first floor fire escape on the north east elevation of the building hereby approved shall only be used in the event of an emergency and shall be used for no other purpose. The door shall be kept closed at all other times.
Condition : 11 - The second floor residential accommodation shall be used only as accommodation for staff working at the premises
Condition : 12 - The kitchen extract flue hereby approved shall be painted black when it is first installed and permanently  maintained in that colour thereafter.
description: Erection of a part three-storey rear extension, part first-floor rear extension, single-storey rear extension, installation of kitchen extract flue and side emergency exit staircase, change of use of first floor to 'family room' for public house, incorporating new parking layout and relocation of vehicular crossover.
